description: Make a native pixel-art variation of this SAME short broken limestone column on its stepped square plinth. Change the broken shaft into an asymmetric jagged split with one taller left remnant and a deep diagonal missing chunk on the right. Keep the same weathered pale gray limestone, muted moss, exact oblique top-down projection, crisp pixel size, scale and upper-left light. Keep the entire bottom stepped plinth and its support pixels unchanged, especially rows40..53; the object must still finish at y53 with two transparent bottom gutter rows. Alter only the upper broken stone silhouette and cracks; avoid adding glowing bits, rubble heaps or new objects. 48x56 transparent canvas with generous clear margins, native one-pixel edges.
